blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Backpropagation remains the dominant training paradigm, using backward gradients and local updates that can suffer from vanishing or exploding gradients in deep networks. Although the Forward-Forward algorithm avoids conventional backpropagation, it remains mainly local or layer-wise, motivating global whole-network learning using forward evaluations only. For shared-kernel wavelet neural networks, we therefore propose a CMA-ES-based global forward-only learning framework. We further introduce structure-aware parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment, factorizing the search into three subspaces. On BSDS500, our method reduces test MSE from 4.1783 to 4.0130 and improves PSNR from 42.621 to 42.787~dB over Adam/BP without backward propagation. Beyond these gains, training requires only 6 training-set coverages, compared with 1500 epochs for BP. Ablations show that structural decomposition and aligned credit assignment are more important than increasing population size, demonstrating the feasibility of whole-network forward-only learning for compact reconstruction networks. These results suggest a potential route toward forward-only optimization of compact reconstruction models for resource-constrained imaging and edge or near-sensor systems.
blocks.zh: 反向扩散仍然是主要的训练模式,使用后向梯度和当地更新,这些梯度在深层网络中会消失或爆炸。 虽然前向算法避免了传统的后向传播,但它仍然主要是局部的或分层的,只利用前向评价推动全球的全网络学习。 因此,对于共享内核波神经网络,我们提出了一个基于CMA-ES的全球前置学习框架。 我们进一步引入结构感知参数分解和频道专用信用分配,将搜索要素化为三个子空间. 在BSDS500上,我们的方法将测试MSE从4.1783减少到4.0130,并将PSNR从42.621改进为42.787~d. B超越了亚当/BP 没有落后的传播。 除这些成果外,培训只需要6个培训对象,而基础教育有1 500个时代。 赤字表明,结构分解和一致的信贷分配比扩大人口规模更为重要,表明整个网络只能向前学习对紧凑的重建网络的可行性。 这些结果表明,对于资源受限的成像和边缘或近传感器系统而言,有可能实现紧凑的重建模型的前向优化。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Image reconstruction is a fundamental problem in computational imaging and low-level vision, where neural methods recover high-quality images from degraded or transformed measurements [ 20 , 1 , 13 ] . Practical systems increasingly require not only reconstruction accuracy but also low memory and computational costs. Multiscale and wavelet-inspired architectures are well suited to this goal because they capture image structures across resolutions while introducing structured analysis–synthesis operations [ 18 , 8 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 图像重建是计算成像和低等视觉中的一个基本问题,神经方法从已退化或已变质的测量中恢复出高质量的图像[20, 1, 13]. 实用系统越来越不仅需要重建的准确性,而且需要较低的内存和计算费用。 多尺度和受波浪启发的架构非常适合这个目标,因为它们在引入结构化分析的同时捕捉跨分辨率的图像结构-合成操作[18,8,4].

blocks.en: Figure 1: Local gradient-based optimization versus global forward-only population search. BP uses backward gradients for local updates. In contrast, our method evaluates complete parameter candidates through forward losses and performs population-based global search with CMA-ES.
blocks.zh: 图1:基于本地梯度的优化与全球前置人口搜索. BP对本地更新使用后向梯度. 与此相反,我们的方法通过远期损失来评价完整的参数候选者,并与CMA-ES进行基于人口的全球搜索.

blocks.en: Shared-kernel wavelet networks combine multiscale analysis–synthesis with cross-scale parameter sharing, yielding a compact trainable parameterization while retaining reconstruction capability [ 5 ] . Beyond model efficiency, such a low-dimensional parameter space can make optimization strategies impractical for large networks tractable.
blocks.zh: 共享内核波纹网络将多尺度分析-合成与跨尺度参数共享相结合,在保留重建能力的同时产生紧凑可训练参数化[5]. 除了模型效率外,这样的低维参数空间可以使优化策略对大型网络可牵引性不切实际.

blocks.en: Backpropagation remains the dominant neural-network training paradigm, using local first-order gradient information for iterative parameter updates [ 14 , 10 ] . Recent backpropagation-free methods, including the Forward-Forward algorithm, avoid conventional backward propagation but remain predominantly based on layer-local objectives [ 7 , 15 , 10 ] . In contrast, evolutionary and derivative-free methods evaluate populations of complete candidate solutions, enabling global exploration without gradients [ 9 , 6 ] . Here, global refers to population-based search over the complete network parameterization rather than guaranteed convergence to a global optimum. Although such whole-network search is generally impractical for large neural networks, the compact parameterization of shared-kernel wavelet networks makes it tractable.
blocks.zh: 后向传播仍然是主流神经网络培训范式,使用本地一阶梯度信息来进行迭接参数更新[14,10]. 最近的无反向传播方法,包括前向传播算法,避免了传统的后向传播,但仍主要基于地层目标[7、15、10]。 相形之下,进取法和无衍生法评价了完整的候选解决方案的种群,使得全球探索能够没有梯度[9,6]. 在这里,全球是指以人口为基础搜索整个网络参数化,而不是保证实现全球最佳化。 虽然这种全网络搜索对于大型神经网络一般是不切实际的,但共享-内核波网的紧凑参数化使其可被取道.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a global forward-only learning framework for shared-kernel wavelet neural networks. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , conventional BP relies on backward gradient propagation and local gradient-based updates, whereas our approach evaluates complete network candidates through forward reconstruction losses and adapts a population distribution using CMA-ES [ 6 ] . Compactness alone, however, does not make naive joint search effective. We therefore introduce structure-aware parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment to align the search with the intrinsic network structure. The resulting framework optimizes the complete network through forward evaluations only, without automatic differentiation or backward propagation.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了共享内核波神经网络的全球唯前学习框架. 如图一所示,常规的业务流程控制依赖于后向梯度传播和以地向梯度为基础的更新,而我们的方法则通过前向重建损失来评价完整的网络候选者,并使用CMA-ES[6]调整人口分布。 然而,光是紧凑性并不能使天真的联合搜索有效。 因此,我们采用结构意识参数分解和频道专用信用分配,使搜索与内在网络结构保持一致。 由此产生的框架仅通过前瞻评价优化了整个网络,没有自动区分或落后传播。

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce global forward-only learning for compact shared-kernel wavelet networks, replacing backward gradients with population-based search. • We develop structure-aware optimization with parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment for effective whole-network learning. • We validate the framework through BP comparisons, structural ablations, and multi-seed evaluations, demonstrating stable reconstruction without backpropagation.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献概述如下: 我们为紧凑的共享内核波浪网络引入了全球前向学习,用以人口为基础的搜索取代了后向梯度。 我们通过参数分解和针对具体渠道的信用分配,发展结构意识优化,以进行有效的网络学习。 我们通过基准点比较、结构调整和多种子评价来验证该框架,表明重建稳定,没有反向传播。

blocks.en: We introduce global forward-only learning for compact shared-kernel wavelet networks, replacing backward gradients with population-based search.
blocks.zh: 我们为紧凑的共享内核波浪网络引入了全球前向学习,用基于人口的搜索取代了后向梯度.

blocks.en: We develop structure-aware optimization with parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment for effective whole-network learning.
blocks.zh: 我们通过参数分解和针对具体渠道的信用分配来发展结构意识优化,以进行有效的全网络学习。

blocks.en: We validate the framework through BP comparisons, structural ablations, and multi-seed evaluations, demonstrating stable reconstruction without backpropagation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过基准点比较、结构调整和多种子评价来验证该框架,表明重建稳定,没有反向传播。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: We review two lines of work relevant to our framework: compact multiscale reconstruction networks for parameter-efficient architectures and backpropagation-free learning as an alternative to conventional gradient-based training.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了与我们框架有关的两条工作线:为参数效率高的建筑建立紧凑的多规模重建网络,以及作为传统梯度培训的替代办法的无反扩散学习。

blocks.en: 2.1 Compact Multiscale Reconstruction Networks
blocks.zh: 2.1 契约式多规模重建网络

blocks.en: Multiscale reconstruction networks exploit hierarchical representations to recover image structures across resolutions. Uformer, Restormer, and NAFNet demonstrate effective multiscale or efficient restoration designs [ 18 , 20 , 1 ] , while wavelet-inspired models such as WINNet and PIRNet explicitly incorporate multiresolution signal-processing structures [ 8 , 4 ] . Recent lightweight models further reduce complexity through parameter-efficient transformations [ 19 ] . Shared-kernel wavelet networks extend this direction by reusing a small set of learnable kernels across scales [ 5 ] . Whereas existing studies primarily exploit compactness for architectural efficiency, we investigate whether extreme parameter sharing can also enable a different learning regime.
blocks.zh: 多种规模的重建网络利用分级代表,恢复不同决议的图像结构。 Uformer,Reformer,和NAFNet演示出有效的多尺度或高效的还原设计[18,20,1],而WINNet和PIRNet等被波浪启发的模型则明确包含多分辨率信号处理结构[8,4]. 近期的轻量级模型通过参数高效转换进一步降低复杂性 [19]. 共享内核波列网络通过再用一小组可学习的内核跨越尺度[5]来扩展这个方向. 虽然现有研究主要利用紧凑性提高建筑效率,但我们调查极端的参数共享是否也能促成不同的学习制度。

blocks.en: 2.2 Backpropagation-Free Neural Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 后传播-无神经学习

blocks.en: Backpropagation-free methods replace end-to-end gradient propagation with alternative learning signals. Forward-Forward and PEPITA use layer-wise objectives or error-driven forward modulation [ 7 , 3 ] , with subsequent extensions remaining predominantly local or layer-wise [ 15 , 10 , 12 , 16 , 2 , 17 ] . MeZO performs zeroth-order optimization using forward evaluations [ 11 ] , while evolutionary methods evaluate populations of complete candidates [ 9 ] . CMA-ES adapts the search mean, covariance, and step size for continuous black-box optimization [ 6 ] , but whole-network search becomes difficult in high dimensions. We instead exploit extreme network compactness to make such search tractable and structure-aware.
blocks.zh: 无反扩散方法用替代学习信号取代端到端梯度传播. Forward和PEPITA采用分层目标或出错驱动的前置调制 [7, 3],之后的扩展仍以局部或分层为主 [15, 10, 12, 16, 2, 17]. MeZO使用前置评价[11]进行"零顺序"优化,而进化方法则评价完整的候选人群 [9]. CMA-ES适应了搜索的平均值,共变,和步骤大小,以进行连续的黑盒优化[6],但整个网络搜索在高维度中变得困难. 相反,我们利用极端的网络紧凑,使这种搜索具有可操作性和结构意识。

blocks.en: 3 Global Forward-Only Learning
blocks.zh: 3 全球只学习

blocks.en: Our framework combines a compact shared-kernel wavelet network with CMA-ES-based forward-only search. We first define the shared-kernel reconstruction model, then introduce population-based search and the structure-aware decomposition with channel-specific credit assignment.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架结合了紧凑的共享内核波浪网络和基于CMA-ES的只前置搜索. 我们首先定义了共享内核重建模式,然后引入了基于人口的搜索和结构意识分解与频道特定信用分配.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the framework through comparisons with backpropagation, structure and credit-assignment ablations, and computational analysis. We first describe the common protocol used across comparisons and multi-seed experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们通过与反向传播、结构、信用分配和计算分析进行比较,对框架进行评估。 我们首先描述了在比较和多种子实验中使用的共同协议。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Experiments use a BSDS500-derived reconstruction dataset. We extract 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches from the original training, validation, and test splits and apply eight-way rotation-and-flip augmentation, yielding 51,200, 1,280, and 12,800 samples, respectively, without source-image overlap. MSE, PSNR, and SSIM are used for evaluation. All methods share the same 177-parameter network, Xavier initialization, data splits, and forward implementation; validation selects checkpoints and the test set remains isolated. The BP baseline uses Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , batch size 32, and 1,500 epochs over ten data-order seeds. CMA-ES uses σ 0 = 0.25 \sigma_{0}=0.25 , M = 64 M=64 samples per generation, and 4,800 generations, corresponding to six training-set coverages. We use λ = 32 , 64 \lambda=32,64 for the main comparison and λ ∈ { 19 , 32 , 48 , 64 } \lambda\in\{19,32,48,64\} for the population study. The choice M = 64 M=64 follows a preliminary ranking-stability analysis, balancing reliability and forward-evaluation cost.

MSE,PSNR,和SSIM用于评价. 所有方法都共享相同的177参数网络,Xavier初始化,数据分拆,以及前行执行;验证选择了检查站,测试集仍被隔离. BP基线使用Adam的学习速度为10 − 5 10 → 5 },批量尺寸为32,超过10个数据顺序种子的1500个纪元. CMA-ES采用相克0=0.25\sigma_{0\}=0.25,M=64M=64个样本每代,并有4,800个代,对应6个训练套覆盖. 我们用" "=32,64\lambda=32,64作主比较,用"λ"=19,32,48,64作"lam"来进行人口研究. 选择M=64 M=64遵循初步排序稳定性分析,平衡可靠性和前置评价成本.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Backpropagation
blocks.zh: 4.2 与反扩散的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares the proposed forward-only learner with Adam/BP. Values are means over ten runs. Without backward propagation, both forward-only configurations outperform BP in reconstruction quality. In particular, λ = 64 \lambda=64 reduces the average test MSE from 4.1783 4.1783 to 4.0130 4.0130 , corresponding to a 3.95 % 3.95\% reduction, while also improving PSNR and SSIM.

blocks.en: The results are also highly consistent across random runs. Across ten runs, the test-MSE standard deviations of Adam/BP, Ours ( λ = 32 \lambda=32 ), and Ours ( λ = 64 \lambda=64 ) are 0.0010 0.0010 , 0.0121 0.0121 , and 0.0008 0.0008 , respectively. The test-MSE coefficient of variation is 0.0241 % 0.0241\% for BP and 0.0209 % 0.0209\% for the λ = 64 \lambda=64 configuration. Moreover, all ten runs of both forward-only configurations obtain lower test MSE than all BP runs, indicating that the gain is not driven by isolated favorable runs.

blocks.en: 4.3 Structure and Credit Assignment
blocks.zh: 4.3 结构和信贷转让

blocks.en: We examine how parameter-space structure and fitness assignment affect forward-only optimization. Figure 3 compares three formulations at λ = 32 \lambda=32 : joint 177-D search with global RGB fitness, 3 × 59 3\times 59 -D structured search with the same fitness, and 3 × 59 3\times 59 -D search with channel-specific credit assignment. The joint search converges slowly and remains at high validation error. Decomposing the search space substantially improves convergence, while assigning each parameter block its channel-specific fitness produces a further large improvement and reaches the low-error regime.
blocks.zh: 我们研究参数空间结构和健身任务如何影响前向优化。 图3比较了QQ=32\lambda=32的三种配方: 联合177-D搜索与全球RGB健身,3×59 3\时间 59 - D 结构化搜索, 3 × 59 3\ times 59-D 搜索与频道特定信用任务. 联合搜索缓慢地汇合,仍然处于高校正错误. 分解搜索空间可大大地改善趋同性,同时指定每个参数阻断其频道的特异性,可产生出更大的改善并达到低强度制度。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Mechanism ablation at λ = 32 \lambda=32 . Validation-MSE trajectories compare joint 177-D search, structured 3 × 59 3\times 59 -D search with global fitness, and channel-specific credit assignment. Curves show median and min–max envelopes over five matched seeds; all runs use M = 64 M=64 and 4,800 generations.
blocks.zh: 图3: 机制衰减=32\lambda=32。 177-D 搜索,结构化 3×59 3\时间 59-D 搜索与全球健身, 和频道特定信用分配。 曲线显示5个种子的中位数和分数-最大信封;所有跑道使用M=64 M=64和4 800代。

blocks.en: The test MSE decreases from 940.23 940.23 for joint 177-D search to 30.81 30.81 after 3 × 59 3\times 59 -D decomposition, and further to 4.04 4.04 with channel-specific credit assignment. Thus, compactness alone is insufficient for whole-network search: parameter-space decomposition is decisive, while channel-specific credit assignment is critical for reaching BP-level reconstruction quality under the tested optimization budget. Together, the two components align the optimizer with the intrinsic RGB-separable structure of the network.
blocks.zh: 测试MSE从联合177-D搜索的940.23 9.40.23减少到了3×59 3\时间后的30.81 30.81 59-D分解,再到4.04 4.04进行频道专用信用分配. 因此,光是紧凑性不足以进行全网络搜索:参数-空间分解具有决定性意义,而频道专用信用分配对于在测试优化预算下达到BP级重建质量至关重要. 这两个组件共同使优化器与网络内在的RGB-分离结构相配合.

blocks.en: We next study the effect of population size. Figure 4 compares joint 177-D and structured 3 × 59 3\times 59 -D optimization for λ ∈ { 19 , 32 , 48 , 64 } \lambda\in\{19,32,48,64\} . Increasing λ \lambda improves both formulations, but even the joint 177-D search at λ = 64 \lambda=64 remains far from the BP regime. In contrast, the structured formulation achieves orders-of-magnitude lower error. As highlighted by the inset, the largest improvement occurs from λ = 19 \lambda=19 to 32 32 , after which the gain saturates. This confirms that parameter-space structure is the dominant factor in forward-only optimization, whereas increasing population provides only secondary refinement after structured search is established.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来研究人口规模的影响。 图4 比较177-D联赛和结构化 3×59 3\时间 59 - D 优化 QQ {19,32,48,64}\lambda\in {19,32,48,64}##. 增加 QQ\lambda 改进了两种配方,但即使是在 QQ = 64\lambda = 64 的 177-D 联合搜索仍然远离 BP 制度. 相形之下,结构化的配体则能实现放大指令下误差. 如套接字所强调,最大的改进发生在从QQ=19\lambda=19到3232之间,之后增生饱和. 这证实了参数-空间结构是前向优化的主导因素,而越来越多的人口在结构化搜索建立后只能提供二次完善.

blocks.en: 4.4 Computational Characteristics
blocks.zh: 4.4 计算特征

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , CMA-ES requires only forward evaluations, whereas BP additionally propagates gradients through all training samples. These counts are not a strict equal-compute comparison: larger λ \lambda increases candidate evaluations, and BP and CMA-ES use different GPU parallelism. We therefore make no claim of wall-clock superiority.
blocks.zh: 如表1所显示的,CMA-ES只要求进行前期评价,而BP则通过所有培训样本传播梯度。 这些计数并不是严格的等分计算比较:更大的QQ\lambda会增加候选评价,而BP和CMA-ES使用不同的GPU并行性. 因此,我们不声称有时钟优势。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This work presented a global forward-only learning framework for compact shared-kernel wavelet neural networks. By combining CMA-ES with structure-aware parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment, the proposed method enables whole-network optimization using forward evaluations only, without automatic differentiation or backward propagation. Experiments on image reconstruction show that the resulting learner consistently outperforms the Adam/BP baseline while revealing that network structure and aligned credit assignment are more important than simply increasing the population size. These results demonstrate that extreme parameter sharing can make global forward-only learning practical for compact neural networks. Future work will investigate its extension to larger architectures and more general vision tasks.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为紧凑的共享内核波浪神经网络提供了一个全球性的唯前学习框架. 通过将CMA-ES与结构意识参数分解和频道专用信用分配相结合,拟议方法仅利用前期评价,而无需自动区分或后向传播,就可以实现整个网络优化。 关于图像重建的实验表明,由此产生的学习者的业绩一贯超过亚当/BP基线,同时揭示网络结构和一致的信贷分配比仅仅增加人口规模更重要。 这些结果表明,极端的参数共享可以使全球前行学习对紧凑神经网络实用. 今后的工作将研究将其推广到更大的建筑和更广泛的远景任务。
